description:
In the middle of today's cultural "gender war," it's easy to pick a side and start throwing punches. But what if there's a deeper truth beneath all the anger and hate? In this video, we take an honest, compassionate look at misandry: what it is, where it comes from, and what can actually heal it. Spoiler: the answer might surprise you.

About: 
Amy McPhie Allebest is a scholar, historian, writer, and independent podcast host. Allebest began the Breaking Down Patriarchy project during her master’s degree at Stanford University in 2020. Her studies there served as the catalyst for the project and podcast. In addition to the project, Allebest is best known for her viral 2016 Medium article titled “Dear Mormon Man, Tell Me What You Would Do.” 
The Breaking Down Patriarchy project uses essential historical texts to better understand the origins of patriarchy and to deconstruct its unjust effects on our minds, relationships, and communities. The project envisions a world in which all human beings are able to flourish and reach their unique potential. We strive to include as many voices as possible, and our work is intersectional and inclusive. We are also firmly committed to the well-being of boys and men, and we enthusiastically and gratefully enlist the help of our non-female allies in creating an egalitarian world where everyone can thrive.

title: Misandry Myths | Chloe Laws | TEDxTeessideWomen
description: In this TEDx Talk, Chloe Laws examines the term misandry and its new-found popularity, unpicking why misandry being levelled with misogyny is a false and dangerous whataboutism: “When we look at all the evidence, the truth is that women do not hate men the way men hate women. Misandry is not the same as misogyny because the oppressed cannot oppress the oppressor. Women do not have the social standing or power for misandry to be a threat. At worst, misandry hurts some feelings. Misogyny, on the other hand, kills women daily.” Chloe Laws is a journalist, poet and gender-equality campaigner, she has written about misogyny and male violence against women and girls for publications like GLAMOUR, Grazia, Marie-Claire, Cosmopolitan, Dazed and many more. Chloe's thought-provoking articles and essays have earned her a reputation as a leading voice in contemporary feminist discourse. Her ability to blend personal experience with broader social commentary makes her work both relatable and deeply influential. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

title: What Is Radical Feminism? - International Policy Zone
description:
What Is Radical Feminism? In this informative video, we will break down the concept of radical feminism and its impact on gender and power dynamics. We will define radical feminism and explain its focus on patriarchy as a primary factor in the oppression of women. You'll learn how this ideology seeks transformative change rather than mere adjustments within existing systems. We will discuss the implications of radical feminism on international policy, highlighting its call for a complete overhaul of societal structures.

Additionally, we'll explore how radical feminism has influenced critical issues such as gender-based violence, reproductive rights, and women's representation in leadership roles. You will see how these ideas have shaped international movements and campaigns aimed at combating practices like forced marriage and female genital mutilation. 

Join us as we navigate through the principles of radical feminism and its relevance in today's global discussions on gender equality and women's rights. This video aims to provide a comprehensive overview of radical feminism's role in advocating for change and its significance in the larger context of international policy. title: What Is Radical Feminist Theory? - Anthropology Insights
description:
What Is Radical Feminist Theory? In this informative video, we will discuss radical feminist theory and its critical examination of societal structures. We will explore how this theory identifies patriarchy as a primary factor contributing to gender inequality. By analyzing cultural norms and institutions, radical feminism reveals how these elements support male dominance and perpetuate traditional gender roles. 

We will also cover the concept that "the personal is political," illustrating how women's personal experiences are shaped by larger social and political systems. The video will highlight the critique of compulsory heterosexuality and how traditional relationships can reinforce economic and emotional dependence. 

Additionally, we will discuss various approaches within radical feminism aimed at dismantling patriarchal structures, including activism that promotes safe spaces for women and campaigns against gender-based violence. By applying radical feminist theory to social anthropology, we can better understand kinship systems, marriage practices, and labor divisions, shedding light on how these aspects maintain patriarchal power.

title: Toxic Feminism vs True Feminism in 90 seconds
description:
In this thought-provoking video, we delve into the world of feminism to uncover the stark differences between true feminism and its toxic variant. Join us as we explore the core principles of both movements in just a few minutes.

Discover how true feminism advocates for equal rights, opportunities, and representation for all genders. Explore its mission to dismantle systemic barriers and challenge gender-based discrimination. Learn how true feminists embrace inclusivity and recognize the intersectionality of gender with race, class, and other aspects of identity. Witness the power of dialogue, education, and awareness as tools for positive change. And see how true feminism uplifts and empowers marginalized communities, amplifying their voices and experiences.

On the flip side, we expose the toxic side of feminism. Uncover how toxic feminism distorts the movement, promoting a misguided notion of female superiority over genuine equality. Witness how it dismisses the perspectives and experiences of men, often leading to division and antagonism. Unveil the dangers of engaging in cancel culture, hindering productive dialogue and growth. See how toxic feminism can undermine the progress of the feminist movement by alienating potential allies and perpetuating negative stereotypes. And understand why it focuses on blame rather than constructive solutions, hindering the pursuit of genuine equality.

Join us on this eye-opening journey as we shed light on the contrasts between true feminism and toxic feminism. Gain a deeper understanding of the importance of embracing true feminism, where unity, collaboration, and empathy pave the way to a more inclusive and equitable society for all genders.
